desc: Implement `count_leq(x)` returning 0 for `x <= 0` (implemented via forward digit DP over `(digit_sum, digit_product, started)` states — exact product is bounded by 9^9 ≈ 3.9e8, so no per-sum modulo DP needed; total states ~50k–90k, well within limits).

Handle leading zeros via `started` flag; acceptance requires `started and product % sum == 0` (sum ≥ 1 when started, so no division by zero; digit 0 after start yields product 0, correctly counting numbers like 10 and 20).
Combine results as `beautifulNumbers = count_leq(r) - count_leq(l - 1)` inside the starter method.

Validate on examples: `(10,20) -> 2`, `(1,15) -> 10`; edge cases checked: `count_leq(0) = 0` (covers `l = 1`), `count_leq(9) = 9`, `count_leq(10) = 10`; tight/free split correctly handles prefix matching and numbers containing zeros.
